bullets.text: L&T secured a large order for AI computing expansion at the Chennai Data Centre, and the office should monitor this megaproject's progress.

stories.title: L&T Secures Large Order for AI Computing Expansion at Chennai Data Centre
takeaways: L&T secured a major contract for expanding AI computing infrastructure at a Chennai data centre facility.
The investment strengthens Tamil Nadu's position as a leading digital and artificial intelligence hub.
